understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid, adjust the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation to match each goal cell, then step onto the matching goal to activate and complete it. All goals in every level must be completed to win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina. Walls block movement, and blocked_directions must be checked before acting because attempting a blocked direction wastes stamina. Shape modifiers cycle through shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange, blue, green, red, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal requires all three attributes to match simultaneously before stepping onto it. When stamina reaches zero, one life is lost and stamina resets; losing all lives ends the game.
